note: The input DTD declaration ATTLIST a id ID makes the attribute type XML_ATTRIBUTE_ID, so later the reader treats the parsed id attribute as an ID and stores it in doc->ids.
When the streaming reader advances past the a element, it frees that element's id attribute; the DTD-derived ID type causes the attribute to be removed from the document ID table.
The ID table entry is made to point at the same attribute-name allocation as attr->name, but attr->name is not cleared after this ownership transfer.
Because XML_PARSE_NODICT is set, the attribute name allocation is freed while the ID table entry still retains the same pointer in id->name.
During reader cleanup, the document ID table containing the stale id->name pointer is freed.
The ID destructor frees id->name, which is the same object already freed as cur->name, causing the heap double free.
